meta.definition: Editorial comparison of what external AI can read, write and how easily it connects. Same combined lens across categories; not a vendor-quality score.

statusDefinition.Production: Dependable enough for a controlled recurring workflow today.
statusDefinition.Test: Worth piloting, but access, maturity or control needs a bounded test.
statusDefinition.Research: Useful specialist capability, not a daily operating interface.

positives: Read posts, pages, blocks, settings and site statistics.
Draft, edit, publish and trash posts and pages.
negatives: Live edits can apply immediately. Free-site access ends 30 November 2026.

positives: Discover and run explicitly exposed WordPress abilities.
Editorial actions depend on additional installed abilities.
negatives: Installing the adapter alone does not supply a complete editorial workflow.

positives: Read collections, schemas, CMS items and site data.
Draft, edit, publish, unpublish and delete CMS items.
negatives: New localised items and site projects remain unavailable; some visual tasks need Designer open.

positives: Read entries, models, assets, locales, references and releases.
Manage content, publish assets and schedule supported releases.
negatives: Configure each environment; CMS publication does not verify the separate live frontend.

positives: Query documents, schemas, projects and datasets.
Create and edit drafts; publish individual documents.
negatives: Release scheduling/publication stays outside MCP; liveEdit types bypass drafts.

positives: Read items, schemas, relationships, files and automation context.
Manage items, files, schemas and configured workflows.
negatives: Draft/publish semantics follow the project schema; self-hosted OAuth needs server configuration.

positives: Query store pages and other authorised Admin GraphQL data.
Create, edit, publish and delete supported pages and articles.
negatives: A coding-agent plugin still needs local CLI/runtime and scoped store access.

positives: Read products, orders and order notes.
Create, update and delete products; perform selected order actions.
negatives: Developer preview. Version 11.3 removes the old endpoint/authentication; draft and publish semantics need checking.

positives: Read product content and selected commerce data.
Create hidden products and edit product copy and SEO fields.
negatives: Early-access merchant MCP, not shopper MCP; no page/blog tools or product publication.

positives: Read and search CMS pages and blocks through REST APIs.
Create, edit and delete pages/blocks; control page activation.
negatives: Traditional Commerce/Magento API scope only; custom integration and visual checks remain.
